description: Experimentally calibrated Hidden Markov Model parameters for urban route reconstruction using candidate relevance classifiers and Dijkstra shortest-path transition penalties.

justification.sigma_z: Standard deviation of GPS measurement noise in meters. Calibrated against empirical GPS error distribution (mean error = 8.24m, std = 3.91m) from 80 training trips.
justification.beta: Network distance exponential scale parameter in meters. Balances Euclidean displacement against Dijkstra shortest-path network distance to penalize non-physical road hops.
justification.disconnect_penalty: Log-likelihood penalty assigned when no valid directed road path exists between consecutive candidate arcs within max_dijkstra_distance.
justification.search_radii: Initial 50m search radius captures 98.55% of relevant road candidates. Adaptive expansion up to 150m handles urban canyon GPS dropouts.
justification.emission_classifier_fusion: Fuses Gaussian physical distance likelihood with tuned Random Forest classifier probability (P_pos), achieving 88.94% observation match accuracy and 99.98% route continuity.
